captions.gbp:
No insurance runaround. No authorization headache. Just one clear price. Self-pay imaging at Advanced Medical Imaging: MRI $295, CT $295, ultrasound $195, screening mammogram $195, bone density $75 and X-ray $50 per body part. MRI and CT with contrast are $395, and a 3D mammogram is $249. The radiologist's reading is included, with no facility or reading fees added later. Most self-pay exams need no referral, and same-day appointments are often available in Seminole and at our St. Petersburg 3T MRI center. Prefer to use insurance? We still verify your benefits and handle the authorization for you. Using Medicare or Medicaid? Ask us what applies to you. Prices as of October 2026.

More at advancedimg.com. General information, not medical advice.

MR Conditional labeling lists permitted static field strength (e.g. 1.5T or 3.0T): FDA guidance 'Testing and Labeling Medical Devices for Safety in the MR Environment'. 3T = 2x 1.5T field, finer detail for brain/prostate/small joints, louder, prices $295/$395, no referral self-pay, same-day, St. Pete address: amiweb services-data.ts 3t-mri and mri entries, pricing page. Could not open the PubMed 1.5T vs 3T systematic review (rate limited). Checked 2026-10-14. Self-pay framing: pricing/page.tsx ('Skip prior authorizations, denials, and surprise bills. Know your price upfront'), services-data.ts MRI FAQ (self-pay same day, no authorization to wait for; with insurance we handle authorization), 3T 48-72h results. Dr. Patel quote drafted by Claude, needs his approval. v3 prices from pricing/page.tsx (MRI 295/395, CT 295/395, routine ultrasound 195, screening 2D mammo 195 / 3D 249, bone density 75, X-ray 50 per part).
